description: List parsed spec clauses with optional filters (kind, section prefix, has_algorithm). Returns lightweight rows {id, aoid, title, number, kind, algorithms}; follow up with clause.get for detail. `spec` selects '262' or '402'.

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

has_algorithm.description: If true, return only clauses with at least one `<emu-alg>`.

kind.description: Filter by clause kind (e.g. 'op', 'sdo', 'built-in function', 'concrete method').

limit.description: Max clauses returned. The full spec has ~3000 clauses; the default is a safe slice.

section.description: Filter to clauses whose section number starts with this prefix, e.g. '22.2' for RegExp or '15' for the Locale-aware operations in ECMA-402.

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: clause.list
title: List spec clauses
